Depending on which calendar is used, George Washington has two birthdays:

*   **February 22, 1732:** This is his birthday according to the **Old Style** (Julian) calendar, which was used in England and the colonies at the time. This is the date most commonly celebrated today.
*   **February 23, 1732:** This is his birthday according to the **New Style** (Gregorian) calendar. 

The calendar changed in 1752, which shifted the dates forward by 11 days.
